question: If the per-step solver cost of exact search is bounded (hard per-query budget, deadlined chain, n_lo deepening off the per-step path), does exact search finish at 12-16 states, where S2 finished 0/24?

motivation.label: Inferred from Observed DIAGNOSIS_027
facts: at 12-16 states over 99% of S2 UNKNOWNs are not run (arm deadline); solver UNKNOWN <= 0.4%
the mean per-case max single query is 13-19 s against a nominal 10 s budget (overall max 48 s)
S2 makes 1.3-1.5 steps/s at 12-16 states; no arm finishes 176 steps
the proven lower bound n_lo stalls at 8.75-10.25 and never reaches n
S2_tight (n_max = n) does not help at 12 states (0/12), so the search cap is not the 12-16 bottleneck; it is at 8 states (S2_tight 9/12 vs S2 3/12)
